restart.finding: The same session and state/workspace paths reopen with existing conversation and result files, but GET harness and the TUI panel show inactive, no run ID, zero Evidence, and no hackathon skill.
restart.impact: Last terminal run presentation and domain/skill continuity are not restored. This is not evidence of a new Ready or of deleted result files.

sourceExplanation.confidence: Consistent with current cached source and live behavior; persisted runtime index implementation not fully audited in this phase.

restart.probeCaveat: Read-only supervisor was started with non-TTY stdin, so stop input was unavailable. Its 120-second watchdog ended the helper with exit 1 and terminated the owned Host (143). Both native TUI processes exited 0.
